name: Vonovia
verdict: Listed German housing company; its largest shareholder is Norges Bank (14.0%), which manages Norway’s sovereign wealth fund. Nothing found.
note: Shirt sponsor of VfL Bochum since 2021-22 (partner since 2016). Rating note: none. Vonovia SE is listed; its half-year presentation shows Norges Bank with 14.0%, BlackRock 8.0%, APG 3.7% and 74.3% other free float, as of 30 June 2026 (vonovia-se-ownership). Norges Bank manages Norway’s sovereign wealth fund; Norway has no sourced record of serious abuses (METHOD.md), so its stake isn’t a link to abuse.
